method: Same960x480 field-normalized, SIFT/RANSAC similarity-registered transient light mask: positive Rec709 luma delta>=20 and max RGB delta>=32 vs entrance; connected components>=24px; HUD cropped and damage/callout text excluded. Mean HSV saturation includes white pixels. Peak=99.9th-percentile Rec709 luma. Six reference field-active samples; three natural actives x2 beats per fixture. No threshold tuned per build.
limitations: Transient masks can include moving bright prop edges; identical detector used on both products. Reference has no isolated effect-alpha layer.
Reference entrances were inspected; the gold sample starts after the cut-in has left the field.
Reference is PvP; no reference boss identity is inferred.

silhouetteMethod: Alpha>=64 at640x360. Maximize intersection under translation only by cross-correlation. No scale/rotation fitting. Fixed camera, root angle and360px semantic height. Higher registered IoU conservatively rejects camera-only differences.
